verses.1: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
verses.2: And let us also walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself up as a sacrifice for us, to God, in order to bring us peace and joy.
verses.3: But prostitution, impurity, and all kinds of excesses shall not be called by that name among you, as it should be for the holy ones.
verses.4: And there’s also the issue of shame and arrogance, or excessive pride. These are things that one shouldn’t engage in, but rather, one should avoid them at all costs.
verses.5: For by this we know that every prostitute, or any person who is unclean or a usurper, is indeed a worshiper of idols. Such people have no right to inherit anything in the kingdom of Christ and God.
verses.6: I will not deceive you with empty words. For this reason, the anger of God will be poured out upon the children of disobedience.
verses.8: For sometimes darkness prevails, but now it’s light in the king’s realm. Just as children move around in the light, so too do they wander around in this world.
verses.9: For the fruit of light is indeed full of goodness, justice, and truth.
verses.10: Testing what is pleasing to the lord.
verses.11: And do not cooperate with those who are involved in the work of darkness. Instead, you should rather control them.
verses.12: For what is done secretly by them is shameful. It’s also inappropriate to speak about it.
verses.13: But everything that is controlled by light becomes visible.
verses.14: For all that is visible, it is actually a light. Therefore, he says: “Come, you who are dying, and rise from the dead! Then Christ will speak to you.”
verses.15: So, you can see precisely how you move around, not as fools, but as wise people.
verses.16: They wasted time, knowing that those days were indeed evil ones.
verses.17: Therefore, do not be unwilling to do so. Instead, consider what the Lord’s will is.
verses.18: And do not be intoxicated with wine, for that is a source of harm. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
verses.19: Singing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to yourselves, and reveling in the joy that comes from your Lord’s love.
verses.20: Thanking always for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, God and Father.
verses.21: Being afraid of each other, in the fear of Christ.
verses.22: The women treat their own men as if they were their husbands.
verses.23: For man is the head of woman, just as Christ is the head of the church; he is the savior of the body.
verses.24: But just as the church is governed by Christ, so too do women govern men in every place.
verses.25: Men, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself for it.
verses.26: To purify her by immersing her in the water of the spring.
verses.27: So that he can show himself as a leader of the church; without having any houses or possessions of any kind. He must be holy and isolated from the world.
verses.28: Similarly, men also owe it to their wives to love them as they love their own bodies. Those who love their wives must love themselves as well.
verses.29: For no one ever divides their own body in half; instead, they keep it intact and whole. Just as Christ kept the Church intact.
verses.30: Because they are members of most parts of his body.
verses.31: Instead, a person will abandon his father and mother, and become attached to his wife. In this way, both of them will be united in one body.
verses.32: This mystery is truly great. I say this in the name of Christ and for the sake of the Church.
verses.33: And you also, each individual person, love your own wife in the same way you love yourself. But the woman should fear her husband.
